nome_articolo: Prime 1 Studio Alien (Film) Museum Masterline XL 1/3 Big Chap Xenomorph Close Up Shot Ver. (Statua)
descrizione:
The dim corridors stir with the silhouette of Rambaldi’s creation. A claustrophobic drama in space, captured on XL. From the film "Alien," which laid the groundwork for sci-fi suspense, the Big Chap Xenomorph Close Up Shot Ver. emerges in Museum Masterline XL. The “Rambaldi Head” defined the Big Chap’s iconic look. This statue stands 100 cm tall at 1/3 scale and features the Close-Up Shot Head based on the work of visual effects artist Carlo Rambaldi. The hood’s transparency, the complex structure around the mouth, and the gaps born of its skeletal design—every element was pursued with on-screen accuracy in mind. Its unsettling pose, impossible to read at a glance, also reflects the tall stature and physicality of Bolaji Badejo, who portrayed the creature. Draped in finely rendered detail, it conveys the suffocating tension of a confined space. The special base is inspired by the interior of the Nostromo. From the rugged textures of the piping to the somber red applied to the mesh plates, the details are built up throughout. Rambaldi’s sculptural beauty and the tension of a sealed space—captured in XL. A collection piece that brings the terror lurking at the far reaches of space within arm’s reach.

Product Specifications:

- Alien - themed Base

- Logo Plates Black
